record.question: There are 8 houses in a line and in each house only one boy lives with the conditions: 1. Kima is not the neighbor of Tluanga. 2. Siama is just next to the left of Muana. 3. There is at least one to the left of Muana. 4. Mawia lives in one of the two houses in the middle. 5. Liana lives in between Mawia and Muana. If at least one lives to the right of Thanga and Siama is not between Rema and Muana, then which one of the following statement is not correct?
options: Thanga is not at the left end.
Thanga is in between Tluanga and Rema.
Rema is in between Mawia and Kima.
There are three persons to the right of Mawia.
